# Shared Gaussian records: an acquired reuse compiler

27 October 2026. This extends the scalar, independent-copy absorption identity
in frozen source S1, Section 6. It preserves that source and the preceding
construction. It is a finite, positive compiler theorem, not a proof of the
general polylogarithmic Gaussian-mean target or a historical novelty claim.

The purpose is precise: a completed approximate Gaussian output can be reused
as a noisy affine center while retaining old outputs. No derivative, mean,
conditional distribution, fitted coefficient, or current-law operation is
queried. Correlated fresh Gaussian seeds pay explicitly for the reuse.

## 1. Inputs that are actually required

Every vector has physical dimension d. A Gaussian seed slot is a d-vector.
For i=1,...,k suppose an already acquired finite program Q_i(c;xi_i), with
q_i seed slots, has the following metadata proved from its source code:

* a deterministic every-execution original-value-query cap N_i and arithmetic
  cap A_i;
* a deterministic nonzero scale r_i and deterministic vector v_i in R^{q_i};
* the exact pathwise gauge identity, for all inputs and seeds,

      Q_i(c+r_i h; xi_i+v_i tensor h)=Q_i(c;xi_i);             (1)

* under independent standard Gaussian seed slots, a standalone law within
  epsilon_i in TV of N(m_i(c), S_i^2 I_d), uniformly over c.

The function m_i is an analysis target, not an oracle. Usually
m_i(c)=E g(c+r_i G), but the theorem does not use this formula. Program Q_i
can contain earlier acquired corrections; its entire actual law is used.
All its original-value calls, coefficient acquisition and finite arithmetic
are included in N_i,A_i. Identity (1) must also preserve every queried
physical point when source-level reuse is claimed.

There is an existing record R=(R_1,...,R_m), with a proved joint contract

 TV(Law(R), N(m,C tensor I_d)) <= epsilon_in,                  (2)

where m is a deterministic vector of unknown analysis means and C is a
known positive-definite m by m scalar covariance matrix. This is a JOINT law
contract. Individually approximately Gaussian marginals are insufficient.
The record is available; its latent standardized Gaussian error is not.

COMPLETED CURATOR MATHEMATICAL REVIEW | 28 October 2026

Decision: accept the listed mathematical/program interfaces at their
explicit contracts. This is a new source-read reconstruction,not transfer of
Q52 first-return acceptance. It is not fresh/blind: the curator retains full
programme/earlier science context and knows A's identity. No producer feedback,
archived scientific execution,external priority search or experiment occurred.
Original supplied diagnostics remain source-reported. Acceptance is of the
specified ideal-real finite algorithms/analysis,not measured executable speed,
finite-bit law,novelty or the general N687 target.

1. Full-joint record absorption. With LL^T=C,TT^T=C_new and
D=[-T^-1 L;H A L],the proposed precision condition gives
D^T D=L^T(C_new^-1+A^T H^T H A)L=I-L^T J L.
Thus P P^T=I-DD^T is a known valid Gaussian covariance. The exact child gauge
turns its noisy center into effective seeds PG-DZ;their complete covariance is
I. They are jointly Gaussian,so all effective slots,retained record and
standalone children have the claimed independence. This is more than covariance
matching of non-Gaussian outputs. TV contracts under the actual Markov kernel,
then independent standalone errors add. All metadata must be fixed independently
of the observed noisy record;data-dependent coefficients invalidate the proof.

Final DAG precision is D_noise^-1-A^T Gamma A. Its positive definiteness implies
the intermediate condition by principal restriction plus unread PSD costs.
The W2 coordinate recurrence pays each downstream center Lipschitz coefficient;
it does not assume independent actual errors. Query caps survive correlated
seeds only because they hold on EVERY execution. Final affine variance must
remain below the target before any fresh reserve is added.

For response closure r=C P1 u and q=[T^-1(u-r);H A r] satisfy D^Tq=0.
The direct energy is u^T(P1-P1 C P1)u;combined with the existing response bound
it yields rho^-1 P1. Child reserve orthogonality kills cross terms. The external
gauge construction has fresh energy s-t and old-response energy<=t/rho,
so its increment is<=sqrt(s/rho). It cannot be declared orthogonal to every
constructed reserve. The unused-slot augmentation preserves actual output and
queries while paying factor2 reserve loss and sqrt(2) gauge growth per promotion.
Neither isolated factor establishes total polylog closure.

statement: For an acquired joint record within epsilon_in of N(m,C tensor I),known child programs Q_i with uniform standalone epsilon_i law and exact query-preserving gauges,and fixed affine read matrix A,a positive correlated-seed compiler retains old means at covariance C_new=(C^-1-A^T Gamma A-J)^-1 when its precision is positive. Full joint TV is at most epsilon_in+sum epsilon_i;each child runs once and old source subtrees are not rerun merely to serve a read.
